cards.title: Injectivity
cards.description: Unique recovery requires distinct admissible inputs to produce distinct outputs.

cards.title: Domain Restriction
cards.description: Inverse interpretation depends on an admissible domain, branch, or regime.

cards.title: Inverse Sensitivity
cards.description: Recovered inputs can be unstable when forward sensitivity is small.

cards.title: Identifiability
cards.description: Inverse reasoning asks whether states or parameters can be recovered from outputs.
